annotations.title: Start a Nod on the GPU and get a pass to talk to it

description: Starts the Nod in a fresh room on our GPU, paid from your balance, and returns the room address and a pass that joins it with a microphone (LiveKit). The Nod says it is an AI agent, then answers. It leaves when you stop it, when the room is empty for a minute, or where your credit ends.
name: start_session
